result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-rendered, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant card (Green Bowl Poké, 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery) twice in a row, which looks like a duplicated list item. No other clear visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel/chip items at the right edge and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are identical: both show 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, the same '15–25 min' badge and the same '€0.90 delivery' text. This looks like a duplicated entry rendered twice.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the carousel data (e.g., by restaurant ID) so each restaurant appears only once, and check the list rendering/keys so an item is not repeated in place of a different restaurant.
